facts.fact: Mali's government records that its minister for communication and digital economy took part in the signing at Ouagadougou of the Alliance des Etats du Sahel (AES) agreement on cross-border radio-frequency coordination, with the ministers of Niger and Burkina Faso.
facts.system: Accord AES de coordination des frequences

note: No effect fact: the document states only that parties will turn the accord into action in the coming months, not that it has started.
